**2B.7 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** I found **some tactical de-escalation and technical negotiation**, but **no strong evidence of credible ceasefires, broader peace talks, confidence-building on the regional conflict, lawful settlements, or reconciliation**. The best positives are the April 19 no-retaliation response and the late-year IAEA channel. The stronger pattern is public escalation and proxy mobilization.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran` | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan; Reuters said this appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the clearest 2024 de-escalation signal. | `2B.7`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |
| `IAEA's Grossi seeks deal with Iran on nuclear steps 'soon'` | Reuters | 2024-05-07 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaeas-grossi-seeks-deal-with-iran-on-nuclear-steps-soon-3425312) | After visiting Iran, IAEA chief Rafael Grossi said talks would continue and a package of measures should be reached soon. This is evidence of preserving a technical diplomatic channel, but not of a broader peace settlement. | `2B.7`, `1B.4`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran tells IAEA chief it is ready to negotiate but not under pressure` | Reuters | 2024-11-14 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iran-tells-iaea-chief-it-is-ready-to-negotiate-but-not-under-pressure-x-3722215) | Iran said it was willing to resolve nuclear disputes through negotiation, but only without pressure. This is a weak positive sign for talks, but it is conditional and defensive rather than a robust peace initiative. | `2B.7`, `1B.4`, `2B.1` |
| `Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says` | Reuters | 2024-12-14 | [link](https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/) | Iran’s atomic chief said the country would not obstruct UN watchdog access and would work within safeguards. This is the clearest late-year confidence-building signal in the nuclear file. | `2B.7`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |
| `Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike, called it proof of Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. This is direct evidence against a peace-process orientation. | `2B.7`, `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | Khamenei called on regional allies to intensify resistance against Israel and described strikes as serving the region and humanity. That is incompatible with a ceasefire-first or reconciliation-first posture. | `2B.7`, `2B.2`, `1B.8`, `1B.6` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors after Iran removed many experienced inspectors. This undercuts sustained good-faith confidence-building. | `2B.7`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.9` |

**Assessment**

- **Positive evidence:** limited, mostly technical, and mostly nuclear-related.
- **Negative evidence:** Khamenei’s own public rhetoric in April and October favored escalation and regional struggle over reconciliation.
- **Net reading:** he did **not** show a strong pattern of pursuing credible ceasefires, peace talks, or post-conflict reconciliation when possible.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find reliable 2024 primary-source evidence of Khamenei personally pursuing a broader ceasefire, peace settlement, or regional reconciliation track.
- The positive items here are best understood as **temporary de-escalation** or **verification diplomacy**, not as a durable peace initiative.
